newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners, Tenet in network pact.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners, Tenet in network pact.

text.p: MedPartners Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to form an extensive provider contracting network in southern California with Tenet Healthcare Corp.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Under the terms of the proposed agreement, Tenet will acquire MedPartners' 99-bed Pioneer Hospital in Artesia, California.
The 100,000 HMO members currently served by Pioneer will be served by Tenet's area hospitals under a 10-year, full-risk capitated arrangement.

The 1.2 million Southern California MedPartners members will be able to access health-care services at all of Tenet's Southern California facilities, in addition to the existing hospital relationships in the MedPartners network throughout Southern California.
The transaction also calls for the development of a provider network encompassing Los Angeles and Orange counties.
Tenet's 33 acute-care hospitals in Southern California and more than 4,000 physicians would be included.
The non-exclusive relationship allows either organization to develop relationships with other medical groups or hospitals.
